notes.title: A Leaderboard Update!
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks to everyone buying Lupinball during the Steam winter sale! It's our most successful Steam sale to date, and it will only get better from here.

On our Facebook page, I teased a change coming to Lupinball that will keep the player base engaged, and motivate new players to work their way up.

[h1]What's changing with the leaderboard?[/h1]

[b]Starting 2018, the Lupinball leaderboard will represent wins for that month.[/b] At the end of each month, the player with the #1 leaderboard spot will receive glory and fame on all of Lupinball's social media channels, and a new leaderboard for next month will be created.

This update will give all players a chance to be the Lupinball champion, no matter how recent they purchased the game, and will encourage all players to continue playing and work their way up.

[h1]What about the current leaderboard?[/h1]

It will soon be retired, the entries preserved as-is for future Lupinball fans to forever admire! You will be able to view this leaderboard through Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com//stats/429360/leaderboards/1541715

We have plenty more Lupinball updates after this! Stay tuned and keep awoo'ing.

Michael

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 11/7/2017
notes.content:
This update adds a new feature: whenever a new lobby is created, the official Lupinball Discord server is notified.

Even if you don't use Discord, this will notify our Lupinball community that an empty lobby is now available. There is no more need for a separate step of logging in to Discord and asking around for opponents.

Of course, nobody likes being a lone wolf, so if you want to join our Discord community and chat with the Lupin-ballers, please do so here: https://discord.me/lupinball

Thanks for the support as we continue to grow our player base and make it easier to find matches!

Michael

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 3
notes.content:
More fixes, thanks to you all!

[list]
[*]REALLY fixed the random-stage issue this time. No more lock-ups when choosing Random
[*]Rewrote the shot-collision behavior. It's much smarter and so shots are less likely to get stuck in odd places
[*]Will now send more data during matches, which will make it far less likely to encounter Disconnects when the connection goes bad
[*]Will be smarter with sending data before each round, which fixes a few mid-game join bugs
[*]Will be smarter about syncing the player order, which fixes some issues with player drop-outs
[/list]

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 2
notes.content:
More fixes are here, thanks to your feedback!

[list]
[*]The wind in Gailes now follows the SFX volume setting
[*]The game is better behaved when it tries another match after a disconnect
[*]The game is smarter about sending packets during menus in online play
[*]Selecting the "Random" stage sometimes locked up the game, this no longer happens
[/list]

As usual, you can challenge fellow players, or report bugs to the developers, via Discord. http://discord.me/lupinball

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 1
notes.content:
We just released the first patch for Lupinball, thanks for all your reports!

[list]
[*]Horizontal shots no longer go through seats in Hound Airways
[*]You should no longer get stuck on "The next stage is..." screen without a roulette appearing
[*]Quitting single-player mode causes more stages to appear when going back to single-player mode
[*]Online sync issues
[/list]

Please continue to report anything you find in the Discord: http://discord.me/lupinball

notes.title: Lupinball releases on August 17
notes.content:
Awoo! The time has almost come!

The online is stable thanks to your testing! The stages are fun thanks to your feedback! The word is spreading thanks to your enthusiasm!

All of it will pay off on August 17 when Lupinball is finally released. The final version will have:
[list]
[*] New music, commissioned from Fox Amoore
[*] 15 stages
[*] A single-player score attack mode with leaderboards
[*] More stable online
[/list]

Please tell your friends, watch our new trailer, and add us to your wishlist! Not long now until August 17!

notes.title: Lupinball Beta Build-11574 (6/2/2017)
notes.content:
Thanks to all your reports so far! I've worked hard to solve your issues in various ways, including simulating online play under conditions so bad it makes airport WiFi look like fiber. But anyway here's some fixed issues:

[list]
[*] Loading screen remains forever in some matches on bad connections
[*] Stage roulette remains forever in some matches on bad connections
[*] Audio glitches on the Tails Tiles stage
[*] More polished graphics on some stages
[/list]

Remember to join our Discord to meet other players: http://discord.me/lupinball

notes.title: Lupinball Beta Build-11421 (5/29/2017)
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the second Beta party! There were many bugs found and fixed in this build, including:

[list]
[*] Mid-match joiners can't join if they join at a very specific time. It will also lock up the game for the other players
[*] The disconnect message appearing very often after your first disconnect
[*] Infinite loading indicator while waiting for the next round
[/list]

notes.title: Lupinball Beta Build-11395 (5/22/2017)
notes.content:
Awoo! I solved your biggest issue, mid-game joining crashing the lobby! Now, you should be able to run a match right through to the end even if people join in the middle of it.

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Mid-game joiners no longer cause the host to think it has disconnected
[*] Shots no longer get trapped in corners
[*] Shots will correctly reflect if shot inside very thin obstacles
[*] Item descriptions no longer stay on screen forever
[/list]

In addition, I have uploaded a default Steam controller profile. This means Steam controller users should be able to play Lupinball without any configuration. If you use PS4 controllers as Steam controllers, they should work too.

notes.title: Lupinball Beta 5/16/2017
notes.content:
Confident fixes:

[list]
[*]Dialog box can now be closed by the Enter key
[*]Win screen won't stay forever if you disconnect during then
[*]Loading spinner on top of online menu, if you don't have a leaderboard entry, is now fixed
[/list]

Added code to fix these, but unconfirmed whether it works, so watch out for these:

[list]
[*]Players with poor connections immediately entering and exiting lobbies
[*]Players can take control over the P1 cursor when they aren't player 1
[*]Description of item remains forever
[/list]

Please continue to test this Beta build, and provide feedback in the Discord chat: [url=http://discord.me/lupinball]discord.me/lupinball[/url]

If you aren't in the beta, join our Discord to request a key!
